Text: "This town is going to need a LOT of stone. The Abandoned Farm's old walls are falling down: bring home 5 Stone and keep it in the Bank, you'll want it." Take the road out of town to the Abandoned Farm. Collapsed Walls have Stone.

"An Inn with no ale is just a house! The old farmers grew Hops, and locked them away in their sheds." Find small keys on the Abandoned Farm and open the Locked Sheds. Bring 3 Hops to the Inn (you hand them over).

"The Abandoned Farm is where every adventurer here starts out. Go and knock a few slimes about, and I'll give you something to start your collection." Defeat 3 monsters on the Abandoned Farm. The reward includes a card you've never found before.
Rewards: Pack Medium 1; Binder Card Abandoned Farm 1

Text: "Slimes are taking over the farm, and travellers won't come near us! Thin them out, and bring me back 5 Green Ooze while you're at it." Green Slimes drop Green Ooze. Like everything you find, it's only yours once you get home.
Rewards: Pack Small 2; Room Abandoned Farm: Blue Slime Patch

Text: "Remember that Alchemist blueprint? Build the workshop and the Alchemist will brew you a Health Flask from that Ooze." Flasks refill at the start of every run. Blue Slimes now live on the farm too.
Rewards: Blueprint Shop; Blueprint Tailor; Room Abandoned Farm: Bunny Burrow; Room Abandoned Farm: Bunny Warren; Pack Small 2

Text: "Something BIG is growing on the farm. I've marked its nest on your map." The Big Slime Nest is now one of your map cards. Find it on the board and beat it. (It Vanishes once beaten, so it's once per trip.)
Start Gift: Room Abandoned Farm: Big Slime Nest

Text: "I like to carry a bit of everything. Well, a LOT of everything. Open some Farm Booster Packs and I'll show you a new way to fight." Packs come from quests, chests and the Shop.
"The roads won't be safe until the monsters are thinned out. Defeat 10 of them, any kind, and I'll make it worth your while."
"Good work! There are plenty more out there. Defeat 20 more."
"The travellers are talking about you! One last push: defeat 30 more."

"You keep losing good loot when you fall. My cousin the Tailor could sew you a Save Sack, but she needs soft Animal Hair. Bunny Warriors have moved onto the farm, and they shed like crazy." Bring home 5 Animal Hair and build the Tailor. (Word is someone has been heard shouting from a chest out on the farm...)
Rewards: Pack Small 1; Room Abandoned Farm: Trapped Chest

Text: "So YOU are the one thinning out the monsters around here. I've been watching. Impressive... for a beginner." He taps his staff. "Show me what you've learned. Beat me in a duel, and I'll teach you the deeper arts." Click the Old Master in town to fight him. Losing costs you nothing: try as often as you like.
Rewards: Pack Large 1; Blueprint Dojo; Unlock Talents; Legacy Point 1
